# Contributing to HoursGram Desktop

HoursGram Desktop is a community fork of AyuGram Desktop and Telegram Desktop. Contributions to HoursGram should be opened as pull requests against this repository.

## Build instructions

See [docs/building-win.md](../docs/building-win.md) for the Windows build setup. The GitHub Actions workflow also builds the Windows x64 client for pushes, pull requests, and manual runs.

## Upstream source

This repository retains upstream code and its required notices. Changes originating from AyuGram Desktop or Telegram Desktop should keep their original attribution and license terms. The AyuGram upstream is available at <https://github.com/AyuGram/AyuGramDesktop>.

## Pull requests

Keep changes focused, explain their purpose, and include the steps you used to verify them. Do not include credentials, session files, or personal Telegram data.
